tools.name: list_insured
tools.title: List insured employees (simulated)
tools.description: Simulated — not connected to the Bureau of Labor Insurance. The calling employer's insured employees, and no one else's. Requires an ECR: the employer is known only from the verified credential.

tools.name: enroll_employee
tools.title: Enrol an employee in labour insurance (simulated)
tools.description: Simulated — not connected to the Bureau of Labor Insurance. Enrol a fictitious employee of the calling employer from their start date. Requires an ECR carrying the labor-insurance-filing role; the start date must be today or up to ten days ahead.

tools.name: withdraw_employee
tools.title: Withdraw an employee from labour insurance (simulated)
tools.description: Simulated — not connected to the Bureau of Labor Insurance. Withdraw a fictitious employee of the calling employer from their leaving date. Requires an ECR carrying the labor-insurance-filing role; the leaving date must be today or up to ten days ahead.

tools.name: adjust_insured_salary
tools.title: Adjust an insured salary grade (simulated)
tools.description: Simulated — not connected to the Bureau of Labor Insurance. Change an enrolled employee's salary grade. Requires an ECR carrying the labor-insurance-payroll role.
